name: Natural Lip Balm
subtitle: 100% Natural & Safe, Developed by Experts

benefits.title: 12+ Hrs of Moisturisation
benefits.description: Chapped lips make the kids want to peel the dry skin. This lip balm contains Shea Butter, Castor Oil and Milk Protein which give your lips the care it needs for 12+ hours.

benefits.title: Easy to spread
benefits.description: This lip balm is lightweight and leaves a light, natural-pink-like tint. The perfect replacement for Mumma's lipstick!

benefits.title: Roll-on format
benefits.description: The roll-on format makes it easy to take anywhere and apply anytime without worrying about spillage in your bag.

benefits.title: 100% Safe
benefits.description: A child's lips are the most sensitive of all. We understand that and have made this lip balm with child-friendly waxes without adding mineral oil or silicone.

description:
Keep your kid's delicate lips moisture-filled for 12+ hours with Little Joys 100% Natural Lip Balm.

We've formulated this lip balm with child-friendly waxes and ingredients like Shea Butter, Milk Protein and Castor Seed Oil to lock in moisture without worrying about any side effects.

A perfect solution when you want to heal and soothe chapped lips with a bit of tint!
Roll open the balm and apply whenever needed.

howToUse:
Roll open the balm and apply whenever needed.

"Trisha uses this lip balm everyday because it smells fresh and gives her lips lots of moisture! We uncap it, roll it into her lips, and voila! Moisturised, refreshed lips! Perfect for little ones who bite their lips and whose lips are chapped."

faqs.question: Will this leave a stain or aftertaste?
faqs.answer: These lip balms contain light and pleasant fragrances which keep your kid interested. This is a natural version so leaves no tint.

faqs.question: When do I apply this?
faqs.answer: We'd suggest using it twice a day, once in the morning and once at night.

faqs.question: Why can't I use any other lip balm?
faqs.answer: Little Joys Lip Balm contains child-friendly wax like Candelilla Wax along with Shea Butter and oils which protect your baby's lips without any other side effects.

faqs.question: Can adults use this lip balm?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is safe to use for all.
